links.outcome: Door-to-puncture and transfer times with active smartphone AI notification
links.effect: Door-to-puncture time decreased 15 min (p = 0.009); transfer time from outside hospitals using Viz.ai reduced 37 min (p = 0.04); no significant change at hospitals without Viz.ai.
links.quote: Door-to-puncture time decreased 15 min (p = 0.009) after the implementation of Viz.ai at our Comprehensive Stroke Center.

links.outcome: Patient transfer time after automated large-vessel occlusion detection and immediate thrombectomy-team notification
links.effect: Transfer time decreased 37 min (p = 0.04) at implementing hospitals; no significant change occurred at nonimplementing hospitals over the same period.
links.quote: Transfer time from outside hospitals that implemented Viz.ai was reduced by 37 min (p = 0.04).
